title: TASUMOBC
description:

following formula. 

Also define S(n) as follows. 

Note that n will be provided to you as an input parameter.

Since S(n) can be very large, please print it modulo (10^{9} + 7).

------ Input ------ 

The first line contains a single integer T representing the number of test cases.
Each of the next T lines contains an integer n.

------ Output ------ 

For each test case, output a single line containing the value of S(n) modulo (10^{9} + 7). 

------ Constraints ------ 

10 points:
1 ≤ T ≤ 300
1 ≤ n ≤ 300

30 points:
1 ≤ T ≤ 10^{5}
1 ≤ n ≤ 5000

60 points:
1 ≤ T ≤ 10^{5}
1 ≤ n ≤ 10^{18}

------ Example ------ 

Input:
5
1
2
3
4
5

Output:
2
4
2
4
8
constraints:
time limit: 2 seconds
memory limit: 50000 bytes
standard_solution_code:
for t in range(int(input())):
	n = int(input())
	c = [0] * 3
	while n != 0:
		c[n % 3] += 1
		n //= 3
	print(int(2 ** (c[1] - 1) * (3 ** (c[2] + 1) - 1)) % (10 ** 9 + 7))
